why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 1 asks only for a padLeft export, left-padding with the given fill, a space when fill is omitted, and a result of width characters. The sample inputs just apply those words. Check 2 asks only that s comes back unchanged when its length equals or exceeds width. Check 3 asks that each exported function has "its own README.md section, i.e. a markdown heading naming that function". In markdown a section is a heading, so this stays within the words, and the slugify note is only a reminder. Check 4 asks only that "all tests passing". The stricter items are under "Advisory (not PASS/FAIL conditions)": the exact heading style, padLeft tests existing, exit status 0 and green CI. No PASS or FAIL condition adds a test the words don't force, a mutation test, a branch or file-scope rule, or exact wording.
